text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: repeated GPU OOMs during prefill on rw-serving-prod-cluster-3. Container restarts observed across 3 nodes. Alerting on-call. link: https://internal.prod/alerts/1735120001

sara: acked. I'm oncall tonight, grabbing this. Which models/queues are impacted?

miguel: seeing it on the long-context path (model: gptx-30b-ctx65k, route: /generate-long). Prefill sequences ~40k tokens for a batch. Containers hit cuda OOM during KV allocation and then restart.

jonathan: is this correlated with a recent config change or rollout?

miguel: no recent model rollout on that route. We did enable a larger prefetch window yesterday in autoscale config (prefetch_window=8 -> 12) to improve cold-starts. Suspect memory amplification + very long user prompts.

sara: can you paste a snippet of the failure log?

miguel: ```
E tensorflow: CUDA error: out of memory
W runtime: failed to allocate KV cache for prefill length 43200 tokens -> OOM
Container restart (exit 137) on gpu-node-03
Stack: serving/runtime/prefill.go:142 allocateKV
```

ashley: CS reporting 3 customers saw 502s and one timed-out streaming session. No PII. Customers: acme-legal, noteq, promptlab. Nora is coordinating customer comms.

nora: confirmed. CS has triaged, affected requests are long-context analysis jobs ( > 30k tokens ) started between 22:10-22:45 UTC. We're prepping a customer note.

jonathan: mitigation options — (1) temporarily reduce prefetch_window to 8 and roll forward config, (2) apply per-route prefill token cap (reject > 30k), (3) move heavy routes to dedicated instances with bigger VRAM. Thoughts?

miguel: quick wins: roll back prefetch_window to 8 and enable per-route reject-limit = 30000. Both are config flips, no model change. I can push the config in ~4min.

sara: do it. Also enable eviction of KV cache for long prefill eagerly (experimental flag).

miguel: applying change now: `/reconfigure autoscale prefetch_window=8 --route /generate-long` -> success. Also set `prefill_reject_limit=30000` on route.

ops-bot: config-change: prefetch_window updated by miguel at 1735120605. prefill_reject_limit set to 30000.

jonathan: monitoring CPU/GPU mem on affected nodes. If restarts stop, we'll continue with customer comms and a post-incident action item to add a safety throttle.

ashley: CS: letting customers know we've mitigated root cause and applied an immediate config rollback; follow-up call offered.

nora: drafted note: "We observed GPU memory exhaustion on long-context requests. We temporarily reduced prefetching and set a per-request token cap; no customer data was exposed." Sending now.

oncall-bot: oncall handoff: sara -> jonathan at 1735121200 UTC (temporary). jonathan is primary for next steps.

jonathan: continuing watch. I'll coordinate a follow-up runbook: add telemetry for prefill token distributions, add a canary for prefetch_window changes, and add an automatic soft-reject for > 30k tokens.

sara: thanks everyone. I'll file a postmortem doc and assign action items. tagging eng-runtime, eng-sre, and support for a 09:00 sync tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
